text: dsh-zh-ui 为中文界面开发提供 DSH 设计规范 skill，并可将项目 DESIGN.md 与 design.tokens.json 注入提示上下文。它还注册 zh_design_lint，检查中文排版、字体、间距、颜色、行高和文案规则，支持多种前端源码。适合需要一致中文 UI 规范和静态检查的开发者；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-zh-ui adds a Chinese UI design skill and project-spec context to DSH. Its zh_design_lint tool checks CJK typography, fonts, spacing, colors, line height, and copy rules in frontend files. Useful for consistent Chinese UI work; no API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 在生成界面时遵循项目里的 DESIGN.md 和设计 token。
有没有工具能检查网页里的中文排版和中英文间距？
帮我静态扫描 CSS 和 Vue 文件里的中文界面问题。
dsh-zh-ui 提供中文界面静态检查：调用 zh_design_lint 并传入工作区相对文件或目录，工具扫描支持的前端源码并返回发现数量及逐条规则提示。
dsh-zh-ui 可在提示组装时读取工作目录中的 DESIGN.md 与 design.tokens.json，并将内容作为运行时上下文附加；文件缺失时不添加该上下文。
dsh-zh-ui 会读取会话工作目录中配置的设计规范文件及用户指定的界面源码；项目规范内容长度默认最多 8000 字符。
dsh-zh-ui 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 21 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-zh-ui README · dsh-zh-ui：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin for Chinese-language UI work. It has three parts:

dsh-zh-ui README · dsh-zh-ui：1. **Skill `zh-ui-design`**: Chinese typography rules (spacing between Chinese and Latin/digits, full-width punctuation, CJK font stacks with fallbacks, line-height 1.6–1.8, 25–40 characters per line), an anti-"generated look" checklist, and a "design direction first" workflow and 4 style presets (observatory, night-shift, cobalt-poster, trust), each with complete CSS custom properties and nav / hero / pricing-card / CTA recipes. Preset text/background pairs are checked against WCAG AA (4.5:1).
2. **Project spec injection**: on every prompt assembly, reads `DESIGN.md` and `design.tokens.json` from the session's working directory and appends them as runtime context (not the cached system prompt). Nothing is injected when the files are absent.
3. **Tool `zh_design_lint`**: static scan of HTML / CSS / SCSS / Vue / JSX / TSX / Svelte sources and Tailwind classes. It does not render pages.

dsh-zh-ui README · zh_design_lint rules：| Rule | What it reports | |---|---| | `hardcoded-color` | Literal colors outside custom-property definitions (`--x:`), and Tailwind arbitrary colors `bg-[#…]`. Colors listed in `design.tokens.json` are allowed. | | `off-scale-px` | px values in margin / padding / gap / font-size / border-radius / inset properties that are not multiples of the spacing base (default 4px); Tailwind `p-[13px]` etc. 0, 1, 2 and token px values are allowed. | | `font-family-cjk` | `font-family` stacks with no Chinese font (PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans SC, …). `var(...)`, `inherit` and monospace stacks are skipped. | | `cjk-latin-spacing` | Visible text where a Chinese character directly touches a Latin letter or digit. | | `cjk-punctuation` | Half-width `, ; : ! ? .` next to Chinese characters. | | `cjk-line-height` | Unitless `line-height` below 1.5 on body-text selectors (headings, buttons, prices etc. excluded); `leading-none/tight/snug` on `

dsh-zh-ui README · zh_design_lint rules：Known limits: the CSS parsing is regex-based, not a full parser; color keywords such as `white` are not detected; contrast, tap-target size and rendered font sizes are not measured — use a rendering tool for those (for example `design_audit` from [dsh-design](https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-design)).

dsh-zh-ui README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:1186258278/dsh-zh-ui
```

For local development, mount the build output with a patch:

```yaml

dsh-zh-ui README · extra.yml：- insert:
    - id: zh-ui
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-zh-ui/lib/index.js'
```

```sh
dsh web --patch ./extra.yml
```

Requires Node 22+ (a `dsh` requirement).

dsh-zh-ui README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: zh-ui
  name: dsh-zh-ui
  config:
    registerSkill: true

dsh-zh-ui README · DSH APIs used：- `ctx.skills.register()` — runtime skill (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`)
- `ctx.on('system-prompt/assemble', …)` — appends a runtime context entry after assembly, as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-working-directory` does
- `ctx.workingDirectory.get(session)` — the session's working directory
- `ctx.tools.register(defineTool(…))` — tool registration (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`)

The lint only reads files inside the working directory; paths that resolve outside it are rejected.

dsh-zh-ui README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm test
```

`demo/` contains an A/B comparison; see `demo/RESULTS.md`.

dsh-zh-ui README · Credits：- [anthropics/skills · frontend-design](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/frontend-design) (Apache-2.0): plan first, review the plan against generic defaults, spend boldness in one place, list of generated-page tells, screenshot self-critique.
- [Viger1/dsh-design](https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-design) design-system skill (license not verified): fix palette and type scale first, one accent, spacing grid, hit area is not font size.
- [SummerSec/SumSec-Skills · taste-skill](https://github.com/SummerSec/SumSec-Skills) (Apache-2.0): infer direction from the product, avoid the cream + brass "premium" default palette, hue-tinted shadows, one radius system.
- [vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines](https://github.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines): `:focus-visible`, no `transition: all`, `prefers-reduced-motion`, tabular numbers, 44px mobile targets.
- [ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max](https://github.com/ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max) (MIT, data from nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill): prioritized checks (contrast, touch, no emoji icons).
